company.name: Orange Slice
company.shortDescription: Orange Slice provides an AI-driven sales intelligence platform that identifies buying intent through online signals.
company.description: Orange Slice provides an AI-driven sales intelligence platform that helps B2B teams identify companies showing buying intent by analyzing online signals such as job postings, website content, and social data. The company offers tools that scrape and enrich data, generate prospect lists, and build automated workflows that integrate with CRM and sales systems to support outreach prioritization. Its platform turns internet activity into structured insights that assist sales development and marketing teams in focusing on prospects with real-time intent signals rather than static lists. Orange Slice’s services aim to streamline lead research and enable actionable prospect targeting for revenue teams.
